text: And Binyamin brought forth Bela his first-born, Ashbĕl the second, Aḥraḥ the third,
Noḥah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
And the sons of Bela: Addar, and Gĕra, and Aḇihuḏ,
and Aḇishua, and Na‛aman, and Aḥowaḥ,
and Gĕra, and Shephuphan, and Ḥuram.
And these are the sons of Ěḥuḏ. They were the heads of the fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geḇa, and they were exiled to Manaḥath.
And Na‛aman, and Aḥiyah, and Gĕra — he exiled them. And Ěḥuḏ brought forth Uzza and Aḥihuḏ.
And Shaḥarayim brought forth children in the field of Mo’aḇ, after he had sent away Ḥushim and Ba‛ara his wives.
And by Ḥoḏesh his wife he brought forth Yoḇaḇ, and Tsiḇya, and Mĕysha, and Malkam,
and Ye‛uts, and Shoḇyah, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of their fathers’ houses.
And by Ḥushim he brought forth Aḇituḇ and Elpa‛al.
And the sons of Elpa‛al: Ěḇer, and Mish‛am, and Shemer, who built Ono and Loḏ with its towns;
and Beri‛ah and Shema, who were heads of their fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Ayalon, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
and Aḥyo, Shashaq, and Yerĕmoth,
and Zeḇaḏyah, and Araḏ, and Ěḏer,
and Miḵa’ĕl, and Yispah, and Yoḥa were the sons of Beri‛ah.
And Zeḇaḏyah, and Meshullam, and Ḥizqi, and Ḥeḇer,
and Yishmerai, and Yizli’ah, and Yoḇaḇ were the sons of Elpa‛al.
And Yaqim, and Ziḵri, and Zaḇdi,
and Eli‛ĕynai, and Tsillethai, and Eli’ĕl,
and Aḏayah, and Berayah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shim‛i.
And Yishpan, and Ěḇer, and Eli’ĕl,
and Aḇdon, and Ziḵri, and Ḥanan,
and Ḥananyah, and Ěylam, and Antothiyah,
and Yiphdeyah, and Penu’ĕl were the sons of Shashaq.
And Shamsherai, and Sheḥaryah, and Athalyah,
and Ya‛areshyah, and Ěliyah, and Ziḵri were the sons of Yeroḥam.
These were heads of the fathers’ houses by their generations, heads. These dwelt in Yerushalayim.
And the father of Giḇ‛on, whose wife’s name was Ma‛aḵah, dwelt at Giḇ‛on.
And his first-born son was Aḇdon, then Tsur, and Qish, and Ba‛al, and Naḏaḇ,
and Geḏor, and Aḥyo, and Zeḵer,
and Miqloth, who brought forth Shim‛ah. And they also dwelt alongside their relatives in Yerushalayim, with their brothers.
And Nĕr brought forth Qish, and Qish brought forth Sha’ul, and Sha’ul brought forth Yehonathan, and Malkishua, and Aḇinaḏaḇ, and Esh-Ba‛al.
And the son of Yehonathan was Meriḇ-Ba‛al, and Meriḇ-Ba‛al brought forth Miḵah.
And the sons of Miḵah: Pithon, and Meleḵ, and Ta’arĕa, and Aḥaz.
And Aḥaz brought forth Yeho‛addah, and Yeho‛addah brought forth Alemeth, and Azmaweth, and Zimri. And Zimri brought forth Motsa.
And Motsa brought forth Bin‛a, Raphah his son, El‛asah his son, Atsĕl his son.
And Atsĕl had six sons whose names were these: Azriqam, Boḵeru, and Yishma‛ĕl, and She‛aryah, and Oḇaḏyah, and Ḥanan. All these were the sons of Atsĕl.
And the sons of Ěsheq his brother: Ulam his first-born, Ye‛ush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
And the sons of Ulam were mighty brave men, archers, and had many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty. These were all sons of Binyamin.
